goal: Protected-source overlap among ready PRs reports a place in the serial merge queue and passes, instead of failing the required Cross-PR object collision check against each other
dispatcher: repo-maintenance session for issue #3721 (Claude chat eac6b686-2bdd-4fce-91fe-47ae8516cb81, edge-dev3)
prohibited_actions: do not change the database-object collision check
do not weaken the fail-closed refusal on an unreadable audit
do not touch any migration or database object
assumptions: the main merge queue ruleset builds and merges one entry at a time (max_entries_to_build=1), re-testing each PR on a main containing earlier overlapping changes
stop_conditions: stop if the merge queue is not serial
stop if the change would need to touch a file outside allowed_paths
